scripts.build: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w driver
scripts.dev: npm run build -w core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.backfill: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w server && node server/dist/backfill/cli.js
scripts.seed: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w server && node server/dist/seed/cli.js
scripts.invite: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w server && node --env-file-if-exists=.env server/dist/admin/invite.js
scripts.worker-token: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w server && node --env-file-if-exists=.env server/dist/admin/worker-token.js
scripts.fixture:canonical: npm run build -w core && tsx server/scripts/capture-canonical.ts
